svg.title: Review before adopting a dependency
svg.desc: The adoption path is shown here. A one-time named inspection tool is a separate bounded branch inside the same command. The reviewer does not install the package. Actual endpoint: A reviewed and explicitly confirmed dependency change. Inspect the manifest and lockfile, then deliver them together through the owning change and commit/PR procedure. Conditions and return paths remain in the companion reading view.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Select the package → review → confirm → inspect the change

svg.title: Review, confirm, then adopt
svg.desc: command: /ca:add-dep: identify the package → agent: dependency-reviewer → command: /ca:add-dep: installation confirmation → command: /ca:add-dep: inspect the adoption. The reviewer verdict and install confirmation are separate. A denied license or unresolved provenance concern blocks adoption.

path.title: review first: The command dispatches its dependency reviewer before any install.
cleared package: Return a verdict before asking for the install action.
confirmed command: Run only the confirmed adoption and inspect its resulting files.

g.title: /ca:add-dep: identify the package. Name the package and exact version. Read the project policy and stack requirements; an omitted version must be resolved before treating a review as specific.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: dependency-reviewer. Inspect license, registry, provenance, maintenance, audit findings and install-script posture. Return findings; do not install or modify files.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
Manrope Variable, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif

g.title: /ca:add-dep: installation confirmation. After the reviewer clears the package, the orchestrator presents the exact install command for your confirmation. A review pass is not that instruction.

text.font-family: JetBrains Mono Variable, Consolas, Cascadia Mono, monospace

g.title: /ca:add-dep: inspect the adoption. Check the actual manifest and lockfile changes. The command requires them to be committed together, never one without the other; use the existing delivery procedure.
